requirement: Apply an update-suspected-cause command to an existing model: copy the pathogen id, severity, and treatment site, refresh UpdatedAt, keep the identity untouched, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The target model is tracked but not yet saved

inputs.text: Command with a new severity and treatment site

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with no error
Pathogen id, severity, and treatment site are overwritten and UpdatedAt refreshed

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
